source.name: ITF World Tennis Tour Juniors 2026 Regulations

ranking.sameTournamentRule: For J100 or higher, only the best result from up to two editions of the same tournament may count within the 52-week period. J60 and J30 may count more than once.

eliminationDraw: No ranking points until a player has played and won a round in the Main Draw.
Advancement through a bye in the first match is not equivalent to winning a round.
Advancement by walkover, or retirement after a match starts, is equivalent to winning a round.
If an event is cancelled before conclusion, loser points for the round achieved are awarded.
If a tournament is terminated and finals are not completed, finalists receive runner-up points.
roundRobin: No ranking points until a player has played and won a match in the Round Robin Main Draw.
A bye in a round robin group with fewer than four players is not equivalent to winning a match.
A walkover win, or retirement after a match starts, is equivalent to winning a match.
